name: Daily briefing
description: Teaches the brain to give a short good-morning briefing: the date, then weather, today's events, tasks, medicines and bills, the shopping list, headlines and timers, from whichever of the weather, calendar, freshtable, news-headlines and alarmflow packages are installed, then one line of encouragement. It adds no tools of its own and fetches nothing itself.
author: Cypher Sisters
consent: This skill is text the brain reads. It runs nothing and uses no internet.
